summary_en: Yamada HD will cancel 301.8 million shares, representing 31.2% of issued shares before cancellation, effective November 30, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares will total 665.0 million.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of All Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On November 6, 2026, Yamada HD announced that its board of directors has resolved to cancel all treasury shares held as of September 30, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The company will cancel 301,843,535 shares of common stock, representing 31.2% of issued shares prior to cancellation. The cancellation will take effect on November 30, 2026. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will be 665,019,664 shares.
